s.g: The upper digestive tract (where food enters the body), especially the mouth and jaws of an animal.
(furry fandom) The mouth and jaws of a furry.
(figurative) Any large, insatiable or perilous opening.
The swim bladder of a fish, especially when used as food in Chinese cuisine.
(Lewis, slang) A person from a rural area of the Isle of Lewis, i.e. outwith Stornoway; a country bumpkin.

maw.f: (informal, derogatory) Initialism of model, actress, whatever: a young woman without much talent who attains celebrity through physical attractiveness

mawa.f: Alternative form of mava (“form of tobacco”).

s.g: (sumo) The belt worn by rikishi during training and in competition
Excessively or falsely sentimental; showing a sickly excess of sentiment.
(archaic) Sickening or insipid in taste or smell.
(Islam) A holiday celebrating the birthday of a holy man or prophet, especially Muhammad.

maws.f: (military) Initialism of missile approach warning system
